_comment: Tests the core-test guard (scripts/suews/check_core_guard.py) may accept without a Linux pass, each by exact id with a reason a reviewer can check. 'allowed': core tests that may skip in a Linux lane (outcome 'skipped'), or core tests marked qgis, which no tier before merge runs (outcome 'not run'). 'collection_skips': test modules that skip while being collected in the Linux cp312 api cell, so none of their tests reach the inventory. An entry that stops applying fails the guard.

allowed.reason: Needs the standalone SPARTACUS executable built with NetCDF and OpenMP (src/suews/ext_lib/spartacus-surface/bin/spartacus_surface), which no CI wheel lane builds; the fixture skips without it.
